source_en: Greetings, Officer. Tina Meskhi, actress, Rustaveli Theatre. You may applaud later.
Yes, the mask. It covers old scars. Everyone asks, so I answer first.
Every actress hides something, Officer. Mine just happens to be the face.
A fire backstage, long ago. Nothing contagious. Stop leaning back.
The last officer and I had an understanding. He adored a good performance.
I'm offering tickets. Front row. What you do with them is your business.
He got greedy, then careless. Someone reported him. Not me.
The house is half empty these days. The show goes on anyway.
